title: A magnificent experience
text:
We have done the via ferrata of Centelles - Baumes Corcades and it has been magnificent. The attention, instructions and help we have received from Cristina, the guide, have been very helpful. Their friendliness and closeness have generated a great atmosphere in the group, which has made the excursion a great experience.

I'm sure we'll repeat!
author: nf0nt

title: Great, when you do a via ferrata, with professional guides, who give you security, highly recommended
text: Great, when you do a via ferrata with professional guides, safety, good treatment, in short veryyyy recommendable
